title: LLHB run metadata
description: Run-level experiment metadata. One document per run (one provider x one condition x one dataset pass). A published number that cannot be traced to a document of this shape must not be published.

dataset_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonical frozen JSONL (FREEZE.md §4); asserted before the run.

model_id.description: Exact provider model identifier, recorded at run time.

api_version.description: Provider API version/date header where the provider exposes one.

analysis_plan_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed confirmatory analysis plan. Must be identical across both arms. Null only for historical runs completed before ruling #30 introduced analysis plans.

system_prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact system prompt bytes. Must be identical across both conditions and all providers of one evaluation.

system_prompt_path.description: Repo-relative path to the prompt text used.

tool_config.description: Condition 'lovspor' only: transport (native-mcp | function-bridge), tool list, schema hash, backend (local stdio + lovverk checkout path/commit). Null for control.

items.description: Namespaced mcp__lovverk__<tool>, the surface of the pinned local lovspor server (METHODOLOGY §5). The server name is part of the claim, not decoration: a bare tool name names no server at all, and a tool named for some other server would let a run with no lovspor treatment in it pass the fairness check as soon as that other server connected.

sampling.description: All sampling/reasoning settings sent to the provider, verbatim; temperature 0/minimum where supported.

lovverk_commit.description: Must equal the dataset lock's pin.

evaluator_version.description: Scorer/extractor version (incl. frozen cue-list and abbreviation-table version) once scoring has run.

notes.description: Free-form operational notes (cap hits, retries, interruptions).
